note: Custom census pools (declarative; no code runs). Y1, Y2 and X1 are built in and cannot be redefined. Row filters: from (all | another pool), where (tracker column = value | [values] | {not: ...}), eo_gte, eo_lt, open_steps_max/min (count of step_* columns that are open), ids_file (repo path, one instrument_id per line), gate_states ({gate: [allowed states]}). default_requires are the gates the census counts. Recorded censuses store the definition used.

CRAIG.title: Craigellachie last-step orders
CRAIG.describe: claim present, not ready, exactly the ending/current basis step open (the 23-order pool of research/excavator/craigellachie-2026-10-20)

NR.title: claim present, not ready (claim repair)
NR.describe: any order with a claim that is not ready for human review

NEAR.title: near-ready
NEAR.describe: not ready, at most one applicable step still open

Y2LEAD.title: Y2 lead-selected
Y2LEAD.describe: Y2 orders whose ending/current gate is held or a lead (what a lead-selected batch would draw from)

Y1END.title: Y1 with an ending instrument if it is a NO

X1S.title: pre-1937 with status (text route)
X1S.describe: X1 pool with a provisional status yes/no: the ProQuest/CSC text route

X1PILOT.title: pre-1937 with status and held text (X1 pilot eligibility)
X1PILOT.describe: X1 orders that hold both a provisional status and an original text: the eligibility rule of the X1 pilot (research/production/x1-2026-10-19/REPORT.md ran all 52 such orders at its commit; this tracker counts the rows that hold both today)

X1T.title: pre-1937 with text, no status (status route)
X1T.describe: X1 pool with held text and no status: the type-rule status route

RASTELL.title: ACT provision missing, acting text held (Rastell)
RASTELL.describe: decided not-ready orders whose claim-kit dossier lists 'target provision not located' for an actor whose mechanism is ending/changing (revocation, supersession, termination, amendment, continuation, ...) and whose held text is acceptable_as_original; excludes 'See:' cross_references and 'acting text absent' (research/excavator/rastell-2026-10-20)

RASTELL12553.title: Rastell sub-pool: EO 12553 targets
RASTELL12553.describe: RASTELL orders whose missing ACT provision is EO 12553 (1986 revocation table)

LAMBS.title: Lambertini savings S0 (shared ending-instrument reading)
LAMBS.describe: decided-NO not-ready orders with savings open whose single EO ending instrument's held text names them with no savings or transfer wording near or anywhere (jobs/lambertini S0_none_candidate), original text and counterevidence done; excludes Rastell batch orders (research/plans/LAMBERTINI_DESIGN.md)

LAMBC.title: Lambertini pre-1937 counterevidence record, no lead
LAMBC.describe: decided not-ready orders blocked on counterevidence by NO_OFR_CATALOG_ENTRY with original text done and no later-events, current-law or WPA lead (jobs/lambertini C0_no_lead_found)

LAMM.title: own fixed term, not ready (Lamm)
LAMM.describe: not-ready orders in claim-kit family own_term:fixed_term whose dossier holds a text (original_source_id set), excluding orders in Rastell batches, Lambertini pools LAMBS/LAMBC and any order with a claim filed (research/excavator/lamm-2026-10-20; Polya reach 650)

LAMMSUN.title: Lamm sub-pool: body/order sunset wording
LAMMSUN.describe: LAMM orders whose best fixed_term sentence (zero-agent screen) is a sunset of a body or the order (shall terminate/expire/remain in effect), an event-relative sunset, a dated period or a member-term clause; excludes retirement-age exemptions and deadline noise

CRAIG2.title: Craigellachie II: blocker source now held
CRAIG2.describe: not-ready orders blocked in Bowditch Y2 or Craigellachie on ending_or_current_basis whose FETCH_QUEUE request was found by the source-ladder run of 2026-10-20 05:35Z (45 new sources) and whose held text was verified as the requested document; excludes orders in Rastell/Lambertini batch files (EO 10976, 11049), orders whose end also needs an EO 12553 ACT record from the Rastell 12553 lane (EO 11387, 11797), and finds that were the wrong document, truncated before the needed section, or gzip-garbled (EO 10440, 11468, 12499, 12502, 11941, 12335, 11065, 11145) (research/excavator/craigellachie-ii-2026-10-20)
